set.st: James Becker is said to have hidden $50,000 in government bonds in the woods near Glidden before he died in 1893. Only 15 cents was ever recovered. LiDAR cache check (USGS 1 m, 2019): Nothing that fits the story stands out within the search area: the pits and lines it finds there are ditches, banks, ponds or natural ground. Period papers put the hut on the banks of a lake on the Chippewa River about 25-26 miles from Glidden, named Gordon Lake in the first dispatch and Bear Lake in the Eau Claire Leader; the 1893-94 search found only 15 cents. The lake is not yet matched to a modern name, so the pin stays approximate.
set.pl: Chippewa River lake about 25 miles from Glidden (called Gordon Lake or Bear Lake in 1893)
